decisions: Use the built-in image_gen tool, consistent with the existing main-shop and studio asset sets; this differs from the legacy Google AI Studio workflow.
Preserve museum-specific 320x480 portrait dimensions; the correct aspect is 2:3.
Preserve museum-specific 32x32 citation icon rather than global item-icon 48x48.
Decorative lotus stamp has no historical seal text or official authentication claim.
Background notebook imagery is decorative; interactive labels and status badges must be provided by the UI.
Reading card uses transparent center; the UI supplies the dó-paper fill and all content.

prompts.bookshelf-view--landscape: pixel art, every pixel a crisp square block, limited palette, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, subtle ordered dithering. Vietnamese heritage museum and archival study inside a traditional Northern Vietnamese timber house. Dark aged lim wood joinery, pale lime-plaster walls, terracotta floor, bamboo blinds, hand-bound Vietnamese dó paper notebooks with plain silk-cloth spines in indigo, earthy brown, deep vermilion and muted golden yellow, simple lotus carvings and a small Bát Tràng blue-and-white ceramic brush pot. Scholarly, tranquil, warm filtered daylight. Strong Vietnamese material identity. Use the supplied studio image ONLY as a reference for pixel treatment, timber materials and warm muted colors; create a new museum environment. Asset: landscape game background. Compose a wide panoramic environment, designed for final 800x500 center crop. LEFT 45%: a large antique bookshelf fully visible, straight on, with exactly twelve clearly separated plain-spined notebooks, four notebooks per shelf across three shelves; modest rolled blank manuscripts and ceramic ornaments in small side niches. Keep bookshelf right edge before 46% width. RIGHT 50%: a broad calm uncluttered off-white plaster wall, a low Vietnamese wooden reading desk only along the lower edge, with blank folded dó paper and a compact brass oil lamp at its far outer end. The reading-card UI will cover the right half, so no prominent object there. Upper 10% subdued clear timber area for HUD and time filter. No baked UI, no panels, no notebook labels or badges. Avoid: photorealistic, realistic, hyperrealistic, 3D render, CGI, unreal engine, smooth gradients, anti-aliased, blurry, soft focus, bokeh, drop shadow, modern text, english text, chinese characters, kanji, hanzi, letters, signature, watermark, logo, western clothing, chinese qipao, korean hanbok, japanese kimono. No humans, no text, no calligraphy.
